items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Wynton comes on, “roux.” There’s a chapter in the first one... and there he is, cute as a button you know.

ctx.x: Now see, I thought I wasn’t going ask about it but—

That’s what I mean, Wynton comes on, “roux.” There’s a chapter in the first one, it’s called R-O-U-X, and it actually says, and there he is, cute as a button you know. “Now you could have all kinds of ingredients, you’re going to make a gumbo see? But you © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
could have them all in there, but if you don’t have roux, you don’t have gumbo, you have gumbo soup, heh, heh, heh” [scats].
